summary: Comprehensive backend testing for Raybotix Digital PWA. 33/33 pytest tests passed covering auth, signup approval, users, projects, tasks, timer lifecycle (start/pause/resume/complete + single-active-timer enforcement), handoff (continue-same & create-next child), reopen, review, project cost aggregation, analytics (dashboard/productivity/employee/costs), messages/notifications, activity log, settings, and role-based permissions. All seed data verified (6+ users, 3 projects, 6 tasks with Urgent-first sorting).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded fallback ('raybotix-dev-secret-change-me'). For production, remove the default so a missing env var fails fast.
routes_users.py list_users: `projection['monthly_salary'] = 0` correctly excludes the field in Mongo projection but is subtly confusable — worth adding a comment (0 == exclude, 1 == include).
routes_tasks.py _iso_to_dt: comparison with timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc) will fail if user submits a naive ISO string (no tz). Consider normalising to UTC before compare.
routes_projects.py compute_project_cost: iterates all sessions per project (potentially expensive at scale). Consider a single aggregation across projects for the list endpoint.

routes_messages.py send_message: sender_id is always appended to read_by[], but read_by[] is initialised to [user['id']] — good. However conversation.updated_at bump happens but no ordering issue observed.

routes_tasks.py handoff (continue same): reassignment_history 'previous_id' is set to user['id'] (the caller) rather than task.assignee_id — will differ if a non-assignee handoffs. Consider using task.assignee_id explicitly.
seed_data_creation: None — used FastAPI startup seed. Tests create isolated TEST_ prefixed tasks/projects/signups; some test data (approved test signup users, TEST_ projects/tasks) accumulates in DB across runs but does not interfere with assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Tests are idempotent (each test creates its own tasks). If DB is reset, seed will re-run on backend startup. Frontend UI still needs testing in a subsequent pass.
